english.note: Use this specifically for someone who betrays or aids the enemy against their own country; it is more pointed than 叛徒.

examples.english: Everyone called them a traitor because they helped the enemy against their own country.
examples.traditional: 大家都鬧佢係賣國賊，因為佢幫敵人對付自己國家。
